title: Unify focus outlines and dynamic color tokens for localized cost timelines
creator: Lina Gomez
description:
Background: The cost timelines and rollout matrices use multiple visual tokens for state (active, baseline, anomaly). In localized builds (fr, de, ja, ar) the focus outlines and color contrast behave inconsistently due to scaled type, translated labels, and CSS variable overrides. This ticket unifies the visual language: a single focus token system and dynamic color token generator tied to accessibility contrast thresholds and locale-specific typography.

Goals: Identify minimal set of tokens, define focus outline rules that work with different font sizes and number formatting, ensure WCAG AA contrast for normal and high-contrast themes, add RTL flip behavior for inset outlines, and prototype in Figma + code sandbox for handoff.

Scope: Console -> Cost Explorer timeline, Rollouts matrix, and Cost cards preview states. Does not include billing settings or third-party embed widgets.

Stakeholders: console-design, frontend-eng, PM: Ravi Menon, Accessibility team.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Focus outlines are present and visible via keyboard for all interactive elements in the cost timeline and rollouts matrix across en, fr, ja, ar.
2) All color tokens meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast against their immediate background for normal and compact densities.
3) No focus styles are lost when locale increases label length; focus rect grows appropriately and remains offset from nearby elements.
4) RTL builds flip inset/outset edge rules and maintain same contrast thresholds.
5) Prototype validated by A11y QA and reviewed by frontend eng; PR with CSS variables and token map merged.
accessibility_checks: Keyboard: tab order and focus landing verified for timeline cells and tooltip triggers
Contrast: measured with axe/chrome devtools for primary/secondary token pairs
Screen reader: focus announcements for active rollouts read contextual label and date
High contrast: ensure OS high-contrast mode maps to token fallbacks
decisions: Use CSS custom properties for token mapping (theme + locale overrides)
Default focus outline: 2px solid token with 4px offset; fallback to 3px for compact densities
Use luminance-aware darkening for overlay borders instead of fixed hex values
Avoid outline:none for interactive SVG controls; add focus ring path overlays
tradeoffs: Using CSS variables increases runtime flexibility but requires a global token migration across console; incremental rollout planned.
A slightly thicker focus ring (2px->3px) in compact mode may slightly change perceived density but improves visibility for low-vision users.
